title: Onboard lyra-14b v1.1: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Aisha Patel
description: This PR onboards lyra-14b v1.1 into the model registry, including canonical metadata, validated performance profiles for common sequence lengths, and automation to generate changelog entries for the registry UI and release notes. Motivation: lyra-14b v1.1 contains tokenizer fixes and a new attention kernel that affects throughput and latency; onboarding ensures customers get accurate perf guidance and that rollouts use appropriate quantization profiles. Changes include: 1) metadata JSON with model manifest, tags, and compatibility matrix; 2) perf profiles for 8/16/32/64 token windows with p95 latency and throughput numbers derived from benchmark-lab runs; 3) CI checks that validate perf profile schema and run a lightweight smoke benchmark in perf-canary; 4) a changelog automation hook that appends a standardized entry to changelog.yaml and emits release notes formatted for the docs site; 5) small docs update and a unit test for metadata validation. Checklist: [x] metadata added and schema-validated [x] perf profiles added and benchmarked [x] changelog automation wired into registry workflow [x] tests added [x] docs updated Related: ENG-4872 for perf regression tracking, PM-1190 for release coordination.
